intro.title: Build cart API with add remove update
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple shopping cart API using Node.js that allows you to add items, remove items, and update item quantities. You will learn how to handle HTTP requests and manage data in memory using JavaScript arrays and objects. The main technologies involved are Node.js's built-in HTTP module for creating a server and handling routes. This hands-on project will help you understand the basics of building a RESTful API from scratch.
intro.usecase: Shopping cart APIs are fundamental to every e-commerce platform like Amazon, Shopify, and eBay, where users add items, update quantities, and remove products before checkout. These APIs power the cart functionality in mobile apps, web stores, and even in-store kiosks, handling inventory validation, pricing calculations, and session persistence. As a Node.js developer, you'll build these RESTful endpoints that connect frontend interfaces to backend databases, ensuring real-time cart synchronization across user sessions. Mastering cart operations prepares you for implementing similar state management patterns in dashboards, configurators, or any system requiring dynamic item lists with CRUD operations.

objectives: Initialize an Express server to handle HTTP requests for cart operations
Construct a data structure to store cart items in memory
Implement an API endpoint to add new items to the cart
Manipulate the cart data to update quantities of existing items
Apply logic to remove specific items from the cart
Configure route handlers to respond with appropriate JSON data
Integrate request body parsing middleware to process incoming cart data
